text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Turn from 65 mm acetal bar: flange 63 mm diameter, 4 mm thick;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: spigot 57 mm diameter (a light push fit in the tube), 18 mm long.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two O-ring grooves in the spigot, 2.5 mm wide, 1.8 mm deep, centred

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 10 and 15 mm below the flange, for 2.5 mm section O-rings.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Eye bolt hole 6.5 mm on the axis, right through.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: SMA bulkhead hole 6.5 mm, 14 mm from the axis, right through;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: check the size against the bulkhead's datasheet.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Light pipe hole 3.0 mm, right through, 13 mm from the axis on the side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: away from the SMA and 10 mm toward the right-hand standoff in the top view.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Inner face: two M3 tapped holes 6 mm deep for the standoffs,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 18 mm each side of the axis, 6 mm toward the side away from the SMA.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Radial holes: drill 3.3 mm, tap M4, through the tube's holes,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4 mm below the flange, 120 degrees apart (one away from the SMA).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the plug pushes in by hand with O-rings greased.
